transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

What pushed me to make the appointment is that I keep starting follow-up tasks after audits or mentorship events fully intending to finish them. Then, days later, I realize the final email, review note, or form just never got done.
How long have you been experiencing this difficulty with following through on tasks?
About a year and ten months. It became much more noticeable after I was promoted following the firm-wide award, when my workload and responsibilities got a lot harder to juggle.
Did you have similar difficulties finishing tasks when you were a child?

Yes. Even in elementary school, my report cards said I was bright, but I’d lose assignments, rush through little details, talk out of turn, and need reminders to finish things. My mother still jokes that I could ace a test but forget a project sitting in my backpack.
Do you often feel physically restless, fidgety, or have difficulty sitting still as an adult?

Yes. During a long review, sitting still starts to feel physically uncomfortable, like pressure building up inside me. I end up needing to stand, walk to the printer, or find some reason to move around.
